topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The small, forgotten corner of my room is suddenly too confined, the air too thick. A parcel, unexpected and heavy, rests on my desk, its presence demanding more than it should. The handwriting on the tag—a name I haven't seen in years—stirs something unsettled within me. I pace, the floorboards creaking under my restless steps. Each moment the parcel remains unopened, the more the walls seem to press in. I know what’s inside could be nothing, or it could be everything. The past has a way of catching up, uninvited, relentless. I need to know, yet the thought of lifting the lid feels like the edge of a precipice, teetering between what I am and what I might become again.
